measurement_note: Size is n, the string length governing the required O(n) complexity. Every tier repeats all five vowels equally, so every input character is rearranged and every vowel type follows the first-occurrence tie rule. The accepted type-counting method and an independent fixed-array implementation take O(n) time. A correct direct-definition control recomputes frequency and first occurrence for each vowel occurrence, takes O(n^2) time, completes all 2500/10000/40000-character tiers, and is rejected only by scaling.
